$comment: ASSUMPTIONS, not measured: the app has no analytics (no firebase_analytics). Replace with real numbers when available (users.availableForGigs ratio, posts/day, messages/day). Every value here is printed in the plan and report under 'Assumptions'.

hourlyArrivalWeights.$comment: Share of session starts per local hour 0..23 (Asia/Manila). Morning commute, lunch, evening peak, quiet overnight.

sessionLength.$comment: Real-time session duration (seconds) is lognormal; think time between actions is uniform. Sessions are NOT compressed — only the gaps between sessions are — so per-session behaviour is realistic and concurrency reflects real dwell time.

primaryIntent.$comment: What the session is mainly for. Sessions also do secondary actions (below), so these are not exclusive.

intentRoleFit.$comment: Intents a role can't perform are remapped: a host's 'apply' becomes 'manage' (review applicants/accept), a worker's 'post' becomes 'browse'.

gigMix.$comment: Host posting mix (open/offered). quick_gigs dispatch runs on the host phone against all online users and is simulated as a read-only matching query (see audit).

chat.$note: Paired sessions run both participants in one generator process so delivery latency uses one clock.

contention.$comment: Deliberate race scenario per stage: N single-slot gigs, each hit by K workers applying and the host accepting two applicants concurrently. Verifies duplicate assignment is impossible.

seedData.$comment: Pre-existing marketplace state created before the stage starts (emulator only by default).

sessionEnd.$comment: Share of sessions where the app is killed instead of paused, so isOnline stays true (the app only clears it on pause/detach/dispose).
